payload.title: Dynamic numpad shortcuts disappear after Hyprland reload

expectation.text: Once the custom numpad plugin has registered its shortcuts, those plugin-provided shortcuts should remain available after a Hyprland configuration reload.

payload.observed: A Hyprland reload cleared the plugin's dynamically registered bindings while the long-running shell service stayed loaded, so the Super plus keypad shortcuts stopped working. This is a corrective repair to an optional custom plugin, not evidence of a stock Omarchy defect.
